model_name: ORION simulated two-body maneuver miss-distance ranker

delta_v_m_s.frame_epoch: burn magnitude; direction is a separate RTN category

direction_radial_plus.frame_epoch: RTN direction label generated by existing simulator at burn epoch

direction_radial_minus.frame_epoch: RTN direction label generated by existing simulator at burn epoch

direction_along_track_plus.frame_epoch: RTN direction label generated by existing simulator at burn epoch

direction_along_track_minus.frame_epoch: RTN direction label generated by existing simulator at burn epoch

direction_cross_track_plus.frame_epoch: RTN direction label generated by existing simulator at burn epoch

direction_cross_track_minus.frame_epoch: RTN direction label generated by existing simulator at burn epoch

target_semantics: Closest-approach distance from the bounded Earth two-body point-mass RK4 simulator; lower values are ranked earlier. This is a simulator surrogate, not a real-world outcome, Pc, safety score, or optimizer improvement claim.
dataset_provenance: Deterministic synthetic Cartesian encounter scenarios generated by app.ai.maneuver_training._scenario with seed 1501; every target is computed by the existing app.services.conjunction.optimize_maneuver implementation.
scenario_generation_assumptions: TCA Cartesian states are synthetic TEME-labelled inputs with primary radius 6800-7400 km, near-circular primary speed within 0.2% of the configured two-body circular speed, relative separation 0.1-20 km, and orthogonal relative speed 0.001-0.02 km/s.
Burn leads cycle through 60, 300, 900, and 1800 seconds.
Each scenario cycles one candidate magnitude (0.005, 0.02, or 0.05 m/s); simulator labels six RTN directions plus a zero-burn baseline, which is excluded from candidate model training.
Labels use the current two-body RK4 simulator and its bounded closest-approach search; simulation limitations are inherited.
split_protocol: 60/20/20 deterministic split by independent scenario_id; all candidate rows from a scenario remain in one partition.
estimator: RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=160, max_depth=12, min_samples_leaf=2, max_features=1.0, random_state=1501, n_jobs=1)

baseline.name: minimum delta-v candidate; deterministic generation order breaks ties

limitations: All training/evaluation scenarios and target labels are synthetic simulator outputs; no real maneuver outcomes were available or used.
The model approximates one specific bounded two-body simulator; it does not discover superior maneuvers and cannot validate the simulator.
No covariance, Pc, spacecraft control, execution error, attitude, propulsion, J2, drag, third-body effects, or operational constraints are modeled.
The simulator's comparison against the stored SGP4 encounter is diagnostic only; neither the model score nor physical miss distance establishes a safe or effective maneuver.
